title: 15.52. Dvigocchaka, Kusalattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Noupādānaṁ kusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca noupādāno nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṁ …pe… avigate ekaṁ.
Upādānaṁ akusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca noupādāno naakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā …. Hetuyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
Nokilesaṁ kusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nokileso nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṁ …pe… avigate tīṇi. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
